page: Microsoft Azure M96bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V. The instance provides 96 dedicated vCPUs derived from 48 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8473C processor operating up to 4.0 GHz. System memory totals 768 GB, offering an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction support includes Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) with AMX-TILE and AMX-INT8, alongside AVX-512 vector extensions covering VNNI and BF16. Local storage consists of a bundled 429 GB solid-state drive with premium storage support. No dedicated GPUs are attached.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional throughput in data-intensive and parallel workloads. The server achieves top-tier results in PassMark CPU performance, PassMark database operations, and encryption metrics, aided by its AVX-512 and cryptographic instruction sets. Memory bandwidth is particularly strong, exceeding 429 GB/sec on uncached large-block reads and reaching 7,441 GB/sec on cached workloads. While single-thread execution sits in the middle tiers, multi-core throughput delivers high performance across Clang compilation, ray tracing, and Redis operations.

From a resource utilization standpoint, the M96bds_v3 provides strong computational and memory density without requiring specialized acceleration hardware. The inclusion of AMX and AVX-512 enables viable CPU-based machine learning inference, demonstrated by strong prompt processing speeds across various model sizes. With 768 GB of system memory paired to 96 dedicated execution threads and local SSD storage, this instance is structured for large in-memory databases, enterprise relational database management systems, heavy data warehousing, and demanding multi-threaded enterprise services.
description: Microsoft Azure M96bds_v3 is a memory-optimized instance featuring 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8473C processor clocked up to 4.0 GHz. It supplies 768 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU allocation, and includes a 429 GB local SSD alongside premium storage capabilities. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V, the system supports advanced instructions including Intel AMX, AVX-512, and hardware-accelerated encryption. In benchmark testing, the M96bds_v3 scores in the top tier for PassMark CPU, database operations, static web serving throughput, and uncached memory bandwidth, while delivering strong multi-threaded compilation and Redis transaction performance. Although single-core scores are moderate, the massive memory capacity and extensive parallel processing capabilities make this configuration suited for in-memory databases, large-scale relational database engines, advanced analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
